title: Implement remaining @objectstack/spec view types: Kanban, Calendar, Gantt, Map
body:
Implements the four remaining ListView types from `@objectstack/spec` view.zod schema. Previously only grid view was implemented.

## Components Added

### ObjectKanban
- Groups records by configurable field (e.g., `status: "todo" | "in-progress" | "done"`)
- Column summaries via `summarizeField`
- Card display via `columns` array mapping to record fields

```tsx
<ObjectKanban 
  schema={{
    objectName: 'tasks',
    filter: {
      kanban: {
        groupByField: 'status',
        columns: ['title', 'priority'],
        summarizeField: 'estimated_hours'
      }
    }
  }}
  dataSource={dataSource}
/>
```

### ObjectCalendar
- Maps records to calendar events via date field configuration
- Month/week/day navigation
- Supports `startDateField`, `endDateField`, `titleField`, `colorField`

### ObjectGantt
- Timeline visualization with task bars
- Progress overlay (0-100%)
- Displays task list with date ranges
- Supports `progressField` and `dependenciesField`

### ObjectMap
- Location-based visualization
- Handles multiple coordinate formats: separate lat/lng fields, location object `{lat, lng}`, string `"lat,lng"`
- Marker list sidebar
- Placeholder implementation ready for Mapbox/Leaflet integration

## Technical Details

All components:
- Follow ObjectGrid pattern with identical data provider interface (object/api/value)
- Convert schema sort config to DataSource QueryParams format
- Use stable ID generation (`event-${index}` vs `Math.random()`)
- Registered with ComponentRegistry for schema-driven rendering
- 105/111 tests passing

Helper function pattern for data fetching:
```tsx
const result = await dataSource.find(objectName, {
  $filter: schema.filter,
  $orderby: convertSortToQueryParams(schema.sort)
});
```
